title: WORLDCUISINES: A Massive-Scale Benchmark for Multilingual and Multicultural Visual Question Answering on Global Cuisines

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision Language Models (VLMs) on visual question answering tasks involving the identification of diverse global dishes and their geographic origins to assess disparities in culture-specific knowledge.

Comparing model accuracy and BERTScore on visual question answering tasks across 30 different languages and dialects, analyzing performance disparities based on language vitality (e.g., 'Winners' vs. 'Left Behind') and language families.
